name: tavx-monorepo
description: TAV-X Tesla Autonomous Tour & Rental Platform

scripts.install:services: for dir in services/*/; do (cd "$dir" && npm install); done
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:services
scripts.build:services: for dir in services/*/; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && [ "$dir" != "services/shared/" ]; then (cd "$dir" && npm run build); fi; done
scripts.test:all: for dir in services/*/; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ]; then (cd "$dir" && npm test); fi; done
scripts.lint:all: for dir in services/*/; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ]; then (cd "$dir" && npm run lint); fi; done
scripts.format:all: for dir in services/*/; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ]; then (cd "$dir" && npm run format); fi; done
scripts.clean: find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name 'dist' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' +

author: TAV-X Team
